property.name: Stream Suffix
property.description: Play from a named go2rtc entry rather than the camera itself, e.g. _t4 for an entry that re-encodes to 1080p Main@4.0. A Control4 T4 panel refuses H.264 Level 5.1 outright and refuses full resolution even at Level 4.2, so it needs such an entry to decode at all. The entry is not a Frigate camera, so it does not appear in the camera list and has to be named here. Overrides Use Sub Stream when set; leave empty for normal operation.

property.name: Camera Audio
property.description: Disabled requests the video track alone (go2rtc "?video"). Control4 plays G.711 u-law but not the AAC many cameras emit, which can leave a client silent or stalled; this gives it video only. Does not affect a T4's intercom, which is a separate subsystem.

property.name: Timeline Reporting
property.description: Report Frigate review items to the Control4 Timeline agent, which Navigator shows as its own scrubbing view. One entry per incident, titled from the GenAI review summary when one is configured. Has no effect on systems where the Timeline agent is not installed.

property.name: Timeline Review Severity
property.description: Which Frigate review severities reach the Timeline. Alerts only keeps it to what Frigate considers worth looking at.

property.name: Timeline Object Detections
property.description: Also report individual object detections to the Timeline, alongside the review incidents. The Timeline tolerates this granularity where the History does not. Arrivals only — a "left" entry on a timeline says nothing.

property.name: Timeline Summary Wait (seconds)
property.description: How long to wait after a review ends for its GenAI summary before falling back to the detected object list. The Timeline entry is stamped with the review's own start time, so waiting does not move it. Set to Off if GenAI review summaries are not configured.

property.name: Timeline Status
property.description: Whether Timeline reporting is actually working.

property.name: Attach Detection Images
property.description: Fetch the Frigate snapshot for an incident and attach it to the History entry, so the entry shows a picture rather than text alone. Needs the Control4 History agent; without it, entries are still recorded, just without the image.

property.name: Record Review Incidents
property.description: Write one History entry per Frigate review incident, with the GenAI summary as its text and the incident's snapshot attached.

property.name: Record Object Descriptions
property.description: Write Frigate's GenAI object descriptions to History, with the described object's snapshot attached. One per tracked object rather than per count transition, so this is separate from Record Object Detections.

property.name: Record Object Detections
property.description: Write person, car, dog, cat and generic object detections to History. Off by default: these fire on every count transition, so one incident becomes several rows and buries the review entry that already describes it. They reach the Timeline instead. Also covers GenAI object descriptions.

property.name: Record Motion Events
property.description: Write Motion Detected and Motion Stopped to History. Frigate toggles this topic constantly, so leaving it on buries the object detections under motion rows. Off by default.

property.name: Record Zone Events
property.description: Write zone entry, exit and loitering events to History. Off by default for the same reason as object detections; the zones involved are already named in the review entry.

property.name: Record Audio Events
property.description: Write audio detections (speech, bark, scream, siren and the rest) to History.

property.name: Record Camera Status
property.description: Write camera online/offline and detection/recording state changes to History.
